items.title: Roy Carew Interview, 1961-06-21
items.q: You were telling us about Eddie Grissel's place?

ctx.x: No, no. I always had other work to do, and it was always a sideline. Did you play with professional groups? No, never played with them. I just fooled with the piano, got to playing fairly well, and it was mostly for my own amusement. I never played for anybody. My dear
You were telling us about Eddie Grissel's place?
Yes, that was a barroom on Iberville Street, or Custom House Street, I should say, and I think at the Corner of Liberty there was a barroom.
